mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.pet_id AS id, p.name AS name, LOWER(p.species) AS type, COALESCE(p.breed, p.species) AS species FROM pet p LEFT JOIN shared_access sa ON sa.pet_id = p.pet_id AND sa.member_id = #{memberId} AND sa.status = 'ACCEPTED' WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND (p.member_id = #{memberId} OR sa.access_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.name
SELECT * FROM member WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(phone, '-', ''), ' ', '') = #{phone} LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM shared_access WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') AND ( (#{memberId} IS NOT NULL AND member_id = #{memberId}) OR (#{recipientValue} IS NOT NULL AND recipient_value = #{recipientValue}) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT sa.*, p.name AS pet_name, p.member_id AS owner_id, inviter.name AS inviter_name FROM shared_access sa JOIN pet p ON p.pet_id = sa.pet_id JOIN member inviter ON inviter.member_id = sa.invited_by WHERE sa.access_id = #{accessId}

SELECT sa.*, p.name AS pet_name, p.member_id AS owner_id, inviter.name AS inviter_name FROM shared_access sa JOIN pet p ON p.pet_id = sa.pet_id JOIN member inviter ON inviter.member_id = sa.invited_by WHERE sa.invite_code = #{inviteCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_access (wallet_id, pet_id, member_id, invited_by, invite_code, recipient_type, recipient_value, role, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{petId}, #{memberId}, #{invitedBy}, #{inviteCode}, #{recipientType}, #{recipientValue}, #{role}, 'PENDING', #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE shared_access SET member_id = #{memberId}, status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE access_id = #{accessId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE shared_access SET status = #{status}, revoked_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'REVOKED' THEN NOW() ELSE revoked_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE access_id = #{accessId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE shared_access SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE access_id = #{accessId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT p.member_id AS id, owner.name AS name, 'ADMIN' AS role, 'ACCEPTED' AS status, 0 AS sort_order FROM pet p JOIN member owner ON owner.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.pet_id = #{petId} UNION ALL SELECT sa.member_id AS id, m.name AS name, sa.role AS role, sa.status AS status, 1 AS sort_order FROM shared_access sa JOIN member m ON m.member_id = sa.member_id WHERE sa.pet_id = #{petId} AND sa.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND sa.member_id <> (SELECT member_id FROM pet WHERE pet_id = #{petId}) ORDER BY sort_order, name

SELECT w.member_id AS id, m.name AS name, SUM(ABS(t.price)) AS amount FROM `transaction` t JOIN wallet w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id JOIN member m ON m.member_id = w.member_id JOIN pet p ON p.pet_id = t.pet_id WHERE t.pet_id = #{petId} AND t.txn_type IN ('PAYMENT', 'WITHDRAW') AND t.txn_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND t.txn_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND ( w.member_id = p.member_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shared_access sa WHERE sa.pet_id = t.pet_id AND sa.member_id = w.member_id AND sa.status = 'ACCEPTED' ) ) GROUP BY w.member_id, m.name ORDER BY amount DESC, name
SELECT log_id AS id, title, description, created_at AS createdAt FROM activity_log WHERE pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE shared_access SET role = #{role}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
UPDATE shared_access SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wallet WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND wallet_type = 'MAIN'
